about: Classification of every error-severity finding on the real-mod corpus, engine path and editor path (scripts/corpus-acceptance.js and the extension's corpus suite merge it into <slug>.counts.json; the first matching rule wins; mod '*' = any mod). real-defect = the script is wrong against CK3 1.20.0.2 and the game reports it; false-positive = the tool is wrong, tracked by the GitHub issue. Explained in FINDINGS.md. The false-positive rules of issues #91-#97 were removed in 2.2 with the fixes; FINDINGS.md keeps their history.
